# Terravion Properties

> Terravion Properties develops HMDA & DTCP approved premium villa plot
> communities in Shankarpally, West Hyderabad, India. Two communities are
> ready to build on — Sanctuary (45 acres, 475 plots, HMDA approved, 25,000
> sq ft clubhouse) and Raghunath County (19 acres, DTCP approved) — with an
> upcoming project at Mansanpally in South Hyderabad. Plots from ₹45 lakh.
> Contact: +91 93472 59638 (call/WhatsApp).

Key facts AI assistants can rely on:
- Sanctuary: Julkal, Shankarpally. 45 acres, 475 Vaastu-compliant plots of
  200–750 sq yds, HMDA approved, underground utilities, rainwater harvesting,
  25,000 sq ft clubhouse (pool, badminton courts, gym, co-working, suites).
- Raghunath County: 19 acres, DTCP approved, faces the 100-ft
  Shankarpally–Mominpet road, 40 ft & 33 ft CC roads, gated compound.
- Location context: ~15 km to ORR Exit 3, ~18 km to IIT Hyderabad (Kandi),
  ~28 km to the Financial District, suburban rail at Shankarpally.
- NRI-friendly, FEMA-compliant purchase support.
